# Bizmis

> Bizmis is a voice-first store clerk for Shopify. It welcomes shoppers, answers questions about products, orders, and policies, and guides them to checkout — like a knowledgeable in-store associate, 24/7.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Bizmis is and how it helps Shopify stores sell more.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans and pricing for Bizmis.
- [FAQs](/faqs): Answers to common questions about setup, behavior, data, and billing.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Bizmis team.
- [Join Waitlist](/join-waitlist): Sign up for early access.
